name: Tata Trusts Individual Grants Programme - Means Grant (Education) 2026-27
provider: Tata Trusts (Sir Ratan Tata Trust / Sir Dorabji Tata Trust and allied trusts)

rules.quote: (i) Indian residents may apply under this scheme.

The scheme is open to school-going students from Standard VIII onwards and college students up to graduation, provided they are enrolled in an institution recognised by the relevant competent authority.
Students pursuing studies anywhere in India are eligible to apply, provided the enrolment is in a school or college recognized by the competent authority

rules.value: at least Pass class in previous exam; ATKT/grace/condonation not eligible
rules.quote: Students should have secured at least “Pass” class in their previous examination (2025-26). (Students who have passed with ATKT, grace marks, or condonation are not eligible to apply.)

rules.value: need-based; no income ceiling printed; income proof for each earning member required
rules.quote: The Means Grant Programme provides partial financial assistance, based on students' needs, to Indian residents pursuing their education anywhere in India.

rules.value: reimbursement basis; fees must already be paid
rules.quote: Since this is a reimbursement-based scheme, the fees should have been paid and the requisite fee receipt should be available with the student.

amount.text: Partial financial assistance based on need (no figure printed); reimbursement of fees for the academic year
amount.quote: Assistance is available for the relevant academic year on a reimbursement basis, subject to the scheme's eligibility criteria and submission of the required documentation.

documents.name: Consent form and application form
documents.quote: 1. Consent Form click here 2. Application Form a. for college studies please click here b. for school studies please click here

documents.name: Attested marksheet 2025-26
documents.quote: Marksheet duly attested by the school or college authority for the academic year 2025–2026.

documents.name: Fee receipts 2026-27
documents.quote: 4. Fee receipt(s) for the academic year 2026-2027.

documents.name: Family income proof AY 2026-27 (ITR / Form 16 / employer letter / income certificate)
documents.quote: 5. Family Income Proof for the Assessment Year 2026-27 (Financial Year 2025- 26). We require documentary proof for each earning member in the family.

documents.name: College/school letter on letterhead
documents.quote: 6. College/School letter as per the shared format.

documents.name: Aadhaar card of student
documents.quote: 7. Aadhaar Card of the student. Masked card is preferred.

documents.name: Cancelled cheque of parent's account
documents.quote: 9. Cancelled cheque of parent’s bank account where the grant, if sanctioned, will be credited.

deadline.text: Apply by email any time before 31 March 2027 for AY 2026-27
deadline.quote: For this academic year, an application may be made any time before 31 st March 2027.
